outcomes.title: Canonicalized provenance and dependency-aware deduplication
outcomes.local_result: canonical URL, title, root, and version dependency audit passed deterministically
gaps_and_gates: distinct authority roots are not automatically independent
tests_and_falsifiers: the same ledger produces byte-stable sorted authority, URL, title, and version groups
source IDs and canonical URLs satisfy uniqueness rules or retain an explicit duplicate relation
DataCite 4.7 and PDG 2026 appear as current-version corrections rather than extra independent support
a false merge fixture or unsupported independence statement prevents completed disposition
outcomes.recovery: retain the failing group, remove only the unsafe normalization rule, and rerun from the portable source ledger

outcomes.title: GMUT variational trace, dimensional matrix, and null-limit rejection audit
outcomes.local_result: action-to-equation trace, dimensions, coefficients, null limit, and negative fixtures passed locally
gaps_and_gates: no empirical GMUT confirmation, canon promotion, or Theory of Everything claim
tests_and_falsifiers: every physical field-equation term traces to the declared action or is explicitly rejected
wrong-rank, wrong-unit, missing-null, and category-collapse fixtures are rejected for their preregistered reasons
the conformal coupling, EFT cutoff, and Wilson coefficients retain units, ranges, observables, and rejection rules
formal success never raises an empirical GMUT, new-law, canon, or Theory of Everything claim
outcomes.recovery: retain every failing fixture, narrow the physical claim, and restore the last passing tracked formulation without editing Sable Rook's branch

outcomes.title: Conservation and stability sensitivity envelope
outcomes.local_result: interior, near-boundary, unhealthy, cutoff, nonfinite, conservation, and convergence fixtures matched
gaps_and_gates: full perturbation, causal, and empirical analyses remain open
tests_and_falsifiers: healthy interior and near-boundary cases satisfy positive kinetic, positive subluminal effective speed, and below-cutoff gates
ghost, gradient, superluminal-proxy, at-cutoff, above-cutoff, and nonfinite fixtures are rejected for the expected reason
equal-and-opposite exchange and homogeneous continuity residuals remain within frozen tolerances
RK4 refinement is deterministic and observed order exceeds 2.5
outcomes.recovery: keep negative fixtures, reduce numerical scope, and fall back to deterministic identities if the solver becomes unstable

outcomes.title: Baseline-first empirical adapter contract and no-download readiness matrix

gaps_and_gates: no dataset, baseline reproduction, unique prediction, likelihood, blind fit, or external replication
tests_and_falsifiers: every adapter has an HTTPS authority URL, current release, access or license boundary, and baseline-first rejection rule
the matrix distinguishes public-no-account, terms-check, account/API-key, licensed, and external-compute gates
no dataset, likelihood, chain, or large product is downloaded and no fit_complete receipt exists
absence of baseline reproduction, a unique prediction, blind analysis, or external review forces open_gap
outcomes.recovery: remove the stale mapping, preserve no-download status, and require a fresh licensed-data and compute plan

outcomes.title: Matched-budget THOS power, contamination, and handoff-loss audit
outcomes.local_result: matched-budget, power, contamination, harness, and handoff-loss design plus scorer calibration exist
gaps_and_gates: no blinded single, replay, or sequential arm was run
tests_and_falsifiers: single-agent, historical replay, and sequential-new-sibling arms share all frozen budget and safe-tool fields
contaminated, broken, reward-hacked, refusal, and handoff-loss fixtures change eligibility or interpretation as preregistered
the design reports detectable-effect assumptions and does not call an underpowered null result equivalence
without blinded arm outputs the final disposition cannot exceed represented

outcomes.title: Freed ID structural profile and cryptographic assurance boundary

gaps_and_gates: no signature, resolution, status retrieval, issuer trust, interoperability, deployment, consciousness, or personhood decision

unknown context, missing proof fields, unsafe controller-holder collapse, stale status, consciousness, and personhood fixtures are rejected

outcomes.title: CBR legitimacy veto matrix with Māori authority routing
outcomes.local_result: structural conflict and authority-veto fixtures matched with Māori routing retained
gaps_and_gates: law, legal advice, enactment, ratification, treaty status, affected authority, and Māori authority require legitimate external processes
tests_and_falsifiers: every case names duty-bearer, affected parties, evidence, process, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, authority boundary, and decision
emergency restriction requires legality, necessity, proportionality, time limit, independent review, and remedy

any enacted-law, treaty, legal-advice, cultural-ratification, or authority-substitution claim fails
outcomes.recovery: hold or reject the clause, preserve dissent and missing authority, and return to applicable law and legitimate affected authorities

outcomes.title: Adversarial artifact and recovery invariant game day

outcomes.title: Stage 20 contradiction, expiry, and downgrade rehearsal

expired or contradicted fixtures downgrade or hold rather than promote
no forbidden GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, CBR, consciousness, personhood, deployment, or reproduction claim reaches E4
